snippet.title: Official Demo Trailer for Pew Pew Magic Wizard Fighter
snippet.description:
Check out the Official Pew Pew Magic Wizard Fighter Demo Trailer Release now on Steam! 

In the mood for a modern take on Retro PVP arcade battle with Wizards, Egyptian Gods and a Hometown Pinball Hero... Enjoy the unique & destructible environments, Non-stop action, power moves and power-ups, killer original electronic music soundtrack and fresh environment art! 

Play Free Demo & Wishlist on Steam Now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4760930/Pew_Pew_Magic_Wizard_Fighter/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=other 

Soundtrack available now!
